Notes

  • "Confirmed Active" programs updated their American Annals of the Deaf listing in 2019 or later; all others are marked "Unconfirmed - No Survey Response (5yr)".
  • Pins are placed at the center of each program's ZIP code, so programs that share a ZIP code share one pin. Clicking that pin shows every program at that location.
  • Programs in Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands are shown in the inset map at the bottom right. Canadian programs in the Annals listing are not included.
